summary: The clipping technique itself: source triangles clipped against the projection box.
overview: Clips each candidate source triangle against a unit projection box, one pass per box face, rather than rendering a flat quad on top or splatting into a render texture. Building the decal FROM the receiving geometry is what makes it follow curves and corners exactly.
useCases: Generating decal meshes from your own tooling.
Understanding or adapting the clipping approach.
Building decals at import time rather than at runtime.

gotchas.title: Cost scales with the receiving geometry's density
gotchas.body: A decal on a high-poly surface clips many more triangles than one on a flat plane. Keep projection boxes tight.
